data.long_meaning: The name Rintu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rintu' which means 'raindrop'. In Hindu mythology, rain is considered a symbol of prosperity and new beginnings. The name Rintu is often given to girls born during the rainy season, and it is believed to bring happiness and good fortune to the child. The name Rintu carries the meaning “Raindrop” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Rintu usually hope their child will grow to embody raindrop and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Rintu is also associated with the Goddess of Rain, Mariamman. In Hindu mythology, Mariamman is the goddess of rain, fertility, agriculture, and health. She is believed to protect her devotees from diseases, and she is often invoked during times of drought or famine.
data.etymology: Rintu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Raindrop.”
